BIGG DOGG / LISTOWEL

Privacy.

Last updated: October 1, 2026

This policy explains how the BIGG DOGG website handles information when you visit the site, use its menu and location links, or contact the truck.

1. Information this site collects

BIGG DOGG does not currently offer accounts, online checkout, payment processing, newsletter signups, or contact forms. The site is a public information and ordering reference.

Information you choose to share

If you call or text 647-679-5006, your phone number and message are handled through your phone and communications provider. The website does not receive or store the content of those calls or texts.

Technical information

When a page is requested, the hosting and security services that deliver this site may process technical request data such as an IP address, browser and device details, referring page, requested URL, timestamp, and security events. This helps deliver pages, protect the service, and diagnose failures.

Necessary cookie

This site may set a first-party cookie named bigg_dogg_cookie_notice for up to one year after you dismiss the cookie notice. It only remembers that the notice was seen. No optional analytics, advertising, or social tracking cookies are currently loaded by this site.

2. How information is used

Information is used to serve the website, maintain its security and performance, publish the current menu and location information, remember the cookie notice preference, and respond when you contact BIGG DOGG directly.

3. Sharing and external links

The site uses hosting and edge-security services to deliver its pages. Links to Google Maps, Facebook, Instagram, and phone or text services take you to third-party services that operate under their own terms and privacy practices. BIGG DOGG does not control how those services process information after you leave this site.

4. Retention

This site has no customer-submission database. Direct calls and texts remain with the communication service used to make them. Hosting and security providers may retain technical logs according to their configurations and policies.

5. Security

The site is delivered over HTTPS and uses reasonable security controls at the web and hosting layers. No internet service can promise that transmission or storage will be completely secure.

6. Your choices

You can clear or block cookies in your browser. Clearing the cookie makes the notice appear again; blocking it does not prevent you from reading the site. If you have a privacy question or want to ask what information BIGG DOGG may hold from a direct interaction, call or text 647-679-5006.

7. Children

This public food-truck information site is not directed at collecting personal information from children.

8. Changes to this policy

This policy may be updated when the site’s features or information practices change. The date at the top of this page identifies the current version.

9. Contact BIGG DOGG
